note: Each item is the user's original checklist requirement, scored against what could actually be checked in this research pass.

items.requirement: Gold purity: confirm the karat — 10K, 14K, 18K (or 24K). Higher karat = more fine gold, softer metal.
items.finding: All 59 rows state an explicit legal karat or 750/1000 hallmark fineness on the seller's official page: 3 in 10K (41.7% gold), 47 in 14K (58.3%), 7 in 18K (75.0%), and 2 in 24K pure gold (99.9%+). Under 16 CFR § 23.3(a)–(b), unqualified "Gold" means 24K only; alloys under 24K must disclose karat.
items.how: Karat read directly from each official product page/feed and verified against the row's verbatim evidence quote by automated check S03.
items.buyer_action: Choose 14K or 18K for prong-set engagement rings (24K is pure bullion softness suited to plain bands, 10K is hardest with least gold), and verify the stamp and assay on arrival.

items.requirement: Solid gold: the listing must explicitly say solid gold — not plated, vermeil, gold-filled, overlay, gold-tone, or hollow.
items.finding: 15 of 59 listings explicitly state "solid gold" in the seller's own text (6 Mejuri, 7 Automic Gold, Ross-Simons 997811, and Aurate Diamond X Ring); the remaining 44 state karat only. Critically, under FTC 16 CFR § 23.3(c)(1) & fn. 32, an item with a hollow center may NOT legally be called "Solid Gold" — yet Mejuri's FAQ and Bold Chain Ring ($348) call hollowed gold "solid gold" (flagged). Aurate's Modern Cigar Band also defaults its base URL to a $118 Vermeil option alongside 14K gold.
items.how: Checked all 59 product pages for "solid", hollow construction disclosures, and plating/vermeil/gold-filled/overlay terms (automated checks S05 & S07), cross-referenced against 16 CFR § 23.3(c)(1) and § 23.4.
items.buyer_action: Get one written sentence before paying: "Solid [10K/14K/18K] gold throughout — non-hollow, non-electroformed, not plated, not vermeil, not gold-filled."

items.requirement: Hallmark: check for a 10K/14K/18K (or 417/585/750) purity stamp PLUS a registered maker's trademark.
items.finding: Zero online product pages display a macro photograph or text transcript of the exact interior shank hallmark + maker's trademark (Cartier states "750/1000" fineness in text, Menē states 24K hallmarking on its COA). Under the National Stamping Act (15 U.S.C. § 297) and 16 CFR § 23.10, any quality mark MUST be accompanied closely by the manufacturer's or seller's registered U.S. trademark or legal name (with 3/7 ppt solder assay tolerances under 15 U.S.C. § 295).
items.how: Inspected all 59 product pages and read 16 CFR § 23.10 + 15 U.S.C. §§ 295, 297 in full.
items.buyer_action: Request an interior-band photo before purchase, and inspect under 10× loupe on day one for BOTH the karat/fineness mark AND the maker's trademark.

items.requirement: Weight: check the ring's weight in grams — a legitimate seller should state or quote it.
items.finding: 21 of 59 listings publish an explicit gram weight on the official product page (ranging from 0.3 g on Ross-Simons 997811 to 7.0 g on Automic Gold Marquise Melted Ring — 9 Ross-Simons, 5 Aurate, 7 Automic Gold). The other 38 rows publish no gram number in static HTML (including Menē's 2 JS-rendered 24K bands) and are left blank, never estimated.
items.how: Opened every single product HTML page across all 59 listings, recovering 5 weights missed by JSON-only reads and adding 9 weighted rings; enforced by check S14.
items.buyer_action: For any of the 38 unweighted rows, ask customer service for the exact metal weight in grams for your ring size in writing before paying.

items.requirement: Seller reputation: check independent complaint records (BBB) and verify real phone, email & street address.
items.finding: Official contact details AND independent Better Business Bureau (bbb.org) records were verified across all 10 retailers on 2026-10-22. Ross-Simons, Blue Nile, Brilliant Earth, and With Clarity are BBB A+ Accredited; Anna Sheffield holds an A+ unaccredited profile; Mejuri, Automic Gold, and Cartier have verified HQ addresses, phone lines, and unaccredited BBB files; Menē publishes audited public-company contacts (no BBB file confirmed); and Aurate New York holds a BBB "F" rating for failing to respond to 8 of 23 complaints (1.22/5 reviews).
items.how: Read official contact/terms pages and BBB business profiles for all 10 sellers; stored in data/retailers.json and data/session-0804e222/retailer-policies.json.
items.buyer_action: Call the customer-care phone number before ordering, verify the physical return address, and treat Aurate's BBB "F" rating + "Final Sale" notices with heightened caution.

items.requirement: Price vs raw gold value: compare asking price against gram weight × karat purity × live spot gold.
items.finding: Spot gold is pinned with publisher timestamp at $4026.70/ozt ($129.46/g 24K fine gold using NIST Handbook 130 § 2.17 exact 31.1034768 g/ozt). Across the 21 weighted rings, price-to-gold multiples span ~1.5×–3.2× on plain 14K bands up to stone-set solitaire multiples; automated check S06 flags any price below raw gold melt.
items.how: Computed from seller-published grams, karat/24, NIST 31.1034768 g/ozt, and timestamped gold-api.com + COMEX GC=F feeds; interactive calculator on calculator.html.
items.buyer_action: Plug the seller's quoted metal grams (subtracting 0.20 g per carat of stones per 16 CFR § 23.18 if total item weight is given) into the Gold Calculator.

items.requirement: Return policy: confirm full-refund window and exclusions on resized, engraved, or custom rings.
items.finding: Official return policies are now verified for all 10 retailers: Ross-Simons (30d receipt), With Clarity (30d receipt, max 1 return/6 mos), Anna Sheffield (14d delivery, 10% restocking up to $500, custom final sale), Aurate (policy says 14d fulfillment, but all 5 ring PDPs say "Final Sale! Exchange for size only"), Blue Nile (30d from SHIPMENT, max 2/yr, $150 cert fee), Mejuri (30d delivery, engraved final sale), Brilliant Earth (30d ship-readiness, $40 engraving fee, no comparative buying), Automic Gold (30d delivery, engraved/custom final sale), Cartier (30d delivery, engraved/altered strictly excluded), and Menē (7d receipt, up to 10% refund restocking fee). Every single seller voids returns if a third-party jeweller resizes or alters the ring.
items.how: Read all 10 official refund/terms pages directly on 2026-10-22; stored in data/retailers.json.
items.buyer_action: Never engrave at checkout, never let an outside jeweller resize or polish during the inspection window, and note whether the 30-day clock starts at shipment (Blue Nile, Brilliant Earth) or delivery.

items.requirement: Payment: use a credit card for statutory dispute protection; avoid wire, debit, crypto, or cash-equivalent BNPL.
items.finding: Verified against official CFPB Fair Credit Billing Act guidance (15 U.S.C. § 1666 & § 1666i; Ask-CFPB en-61 & en-1969): credit cards grant a 60-day written billing-error dispute right (undelivered, unaccepted, or misbilled goods, with payment withheld during investigation) and statutory "claims and defenses" rights on >$50 purchases after a good-faith merchant attempt (statutorily tied to home state or ≤100 miles, though many issuers extend broader chargeback rules — check your own cardholder agreement). Debit cards, wires, Zelle, and non-credit BNPL do not carry FCBA rights.
items.how: Retrieved CFPB Ask-CFPB articles en-61 and en-1969 on 2026-10-22.
items.buyer_action: Pay directly with a major credit card, save screenshots of checkout terms, and send written billing disputes within 60 days if misrepresented goods are refused for return.

items.requirement: Documentation: archive the listing, price, purity claim, gram quote, certificate, and receipt.
items.finding: Every one of the 59 rows in this repository archives the exact URL, retrieval date, verbatim evidence string, price basis, and re-verification quote in data/rings.json and data/reverification.json.
items.how: Enforced on every build by automated provenance checks S01, S02, S03, S14, and S15.
items.buyer_action: Save a full-page PDF of the product page at purchase time, your order invoice, any email/chat confirming solid gold + gram weight, and the GIA/IGI/COA certificate.

items.requirement: Upon arrival: before wearing, engraving, or resizing, take the ring to an independent jeweller inside the return window.
items.finding: Physical inspection cannot be done online — and return windows are as short as 7 days (Menē), 14 days (Anna Sheffield), or 30 days from shipment rather than delivery (Blue Nile, Brilliant Earth). Any third-party resize, prong tightening, or deep scratch test voids returns at all 10 sellers.
items.how: Cross-checked physical inspection steps against all 10 retailers' return-voiding clauses.
items.buyer_action: Book an independent gemologist/appraiser for the day after delivery; insist strictly on non-destructive testing (calibrated gram scale, loupe hallmark read, hydrostatic specific gravity, ultrasound, and XRF) with tags/certificates kept intact.

items.requirement: Professional purity testing: pair XRF with scale weight & specific-gravity density — never rely on stamp or surface XRF alone.
items.finding: GIA Gems & Gemology Lab Notes prove neither a hallmark NOR standalone surface XRF is sufficient on its own: in Spring 2024 (Vol. 60, No. 1), a 41 g resin-filled electroformed bracelet with a glued-on "14K" disk read 17.99K–22.47K on XRF with no plating alert; in Summer 2025 (Vol. 61, No. 2, "Gold-Plated Gold"), 9K/10K gold rings plated with higher-karat yellow gold read 13.5K–18K on XRF because X-rays penetrate only microns. Combining XRF with precision gram weight + hydrostatic specific-gravity (density) testing catches hollow/resin cores and under-karated interiors non-destructively.
items.how: Retrieved and verified GIA Spring 2024 and Summer 2025 Lab Notes directly from gia.edu on 2026-10-22.
items.buyer_action: Ask the independent appraiser for BOTH XRF fluorescence AND hydrostatic specific-gravity + calibrated gram weight, and keep the written test report.

items.requirement: Walk-away rule: if a seller refuses written specs, independent non-destructive verification, or a real return window, do not buy.
items.finding: Applied across all 59 listings: inquiry-only archive pages (Anna Sheffield Bea Solitaire & Hazeline), "Final Sale! Exchange for size only" pages + BBB "F" rating (Aurate), dead URLs (Cartier CRN4744700, Blue Nile 203242), and unavailable exchange-only listings (Tiffany GRP10863) are explicitly flagged or excluded rather than smoothed over.
items.how: Every gap is surfaced as a visible warning chip on the row and documented on flagged.html.
items.buyer_action: If a seller refuses to state solid non-hollow karat gold and approximate gram weight in writing, or marks your ring Final Sale, walk away — compare the 21 weight-disclosed rings on weights.html instead.
